roms.label: Stable-Retro Genesis integration ROM
roms.compatibility_notes: This SHA-1 identifies the Stable-Retro integration input. The additional address evidence comes from World cheat records whose exact ROM revision has not been matched to this SHA-1. Validate every property with the locally loaded ROM before relying on it.

properties.description: Player 1's stored health or energy value.
properties.notes: Golden Axe's visible health bars use game-specific damage scaling. Runtime testing must establish how this raw value corresponds to the displayed bar.
The useful maximum magic value depends on the selected character. Use the Player 1 Character Modifier property when creating character-specific EDAS actions.

properties.description: Raw value labelled Character Modifier in a Golden Axe World cheat record.
properties.notes: The source does not document the raw character IDs or independently prove this is Player 1. It is grouped with the directly labelled Player 1 values only as a working hypothesis; do not use it for character-specific actions until tested.

properties.description: Player 1 invincibility flag used by a Golden Axe World Action Replay record.
properties.notes: The Action Replay record writes 1 to enable invincibility. Confirm the inactive value and whether the flag is transient before using it as a gameplay condition.

properties.description: Raw Player 1 attack-related state sampled by the libretro Golden Axe rumble preset.
properties.notes: The rumble preset reacts to source-defined value 156. The complete state encoding and which attacks it represents require runtime inspection.
Only valid while the Player 1 continue screen is active. The source freezes this value at 9; confirm its displayed-unit conversion.
Only meaningful when a second player is active.

properties.description: Player 2's stored health or energy value.
properties.notes: Only meaningful when a second player is active. Runtime testing must establish how this raw value corresponds to the displayed health bar.
Only meaningful when a second player is active. The useful maximum depends on the selected character.
Only meaningful when a second player is active and the continue screen is active. The source freezes this value at 9; confirm its displayed-unit conversion.

properties.description: Shared credit count used by Golden Axe's continue flow.
properties.notes: The source uses this address for an infinite-credits cheat. Confirm the ordinary range and whether it is active outside a continue screen.

Only valid in Duel Mode. This address was previously imported as Player 1 Score from Stable-Retro, but an independent Golden Axe cheat record identifies it as the Duel Mode timer. Do not use it as a score value.

provenance.summary: Research-backed experimental Golden Axe work-RAM layout. No ROM content is included. Every property requires EDAS runtime validation against the matching ROM and emulator core before promotion beyond experimental or unverified.

sources.name: libretro-database
source_paths: cht/Sega - Mega Drive - Genesis/Golden Axe (World) (Action Replay).cht
sources.contribution: Directly labelled Player 1 and Player 2 lives, health and magic addresses; credits, Duel Mode timer, continue timers, Player 1 invincibility, Character Modifier, and the attack-related rumble sample.
sources.address_conversion: Full 68000 work-RAM addresses in 0xFF0000-0xFFFFFF are represented as core_ram offsets by subtracting 0xFF0000. The EDAS Mega Drive reader convention uses byte_order swap16 and big endian.
sources.limitations: Cheat labels establish useful address semantics but rarely document raw type widths, inactive values, character IDs, or exact ROM-revision compatibility.

sources.name: Stable-Retro
sources.contribution: Provides the retained SHA-1 identity and the original two-value import used as a comparison point.
sources.limitations: The former score label at 0x00FFFE72 conflicts with an independent Duel Mode timer record and is intentionally not retained as score telemetry.

sources.name: GameFAQs Golden Axe guide
sources.contribution: Documents gameplay health-bar and magic-damage behaviour used to qualify health and magic notes.
sources.limitations: Does not provide the work-RAM addresses used in this definition.

sources.name: GameHacking.org Golden Axe record
sources.contribution: Corroborating public technical record for Golden Axe cheat support and a World-region ROM CRC listing.
sources.limitations: Its listed CRC has not been matched to the Stable-Retro SHA-1, so it is not added as a hash for this ROM entry.
